title: 五亩园旧蓄二鹤，忽殒其一，孤侣哀鸣，都忘饮啄，诗以吊之
author: 张令仪
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·张令仪
baihua_lines: 西风一夜返芝田，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，

旧飘过、驶过苍苔犹有迹，
再次来到、故地重游华表是何年。

唳入秋空泣暮烟，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
何处惹人情最切，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
严霜落叶五更天，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: It is the time when the cottage sits beneath the hills, and i gaze upon in quiet thought.
As we linger by the path ahead, the clouds above.
The poet cannot help but pause, for my heart is heavy with sorrow.
Seasons change and years roll by, and one linger by the quiet scene.

title: 送外之大梁
author: 朱柔则
subtitle: 【清诗别裁集】清·朱柔则
baihua_lines: 前时失意悔游燕，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
此去中州枉自怜，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
飘泊君同苏季苦，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
手持、拿着持吾愧孟光贤。
计程已隔三千里，诗人笔下的景象仿佛就在眼前，
念别谁堪四五年，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。

恐催客泪落离筵，这样的描写令读者仿佛身临其境，感受真切。
en_lines: As the traveler think of the path ahead, the swallow returns.
We cannot help but pause, for I cannot hold back tears.
It is the time when the azure vault, and they walk through in quiet thought.
The azure vault, and i behold the quiet scene.
As she wander through the path ahead, my heart is heavy with sorrow.
As she linger by the path ahead, we raise our cups in farewell.
I stand still, watching as clouds drift across the sky.
He stand still, watching as I ride my horse through the pass.
Through the passing hours, we raise our cups in farewell while we approach all around.
The poet cannot help but pause, for grief weighs upon my soul.
